title: Official Hanson ROS 2 interface intake
description: Closed, source-aware intake for simulator-first mapping. Empty and unresolved fields are intentional until Hanson supplies official values.

authorityBoundary.description: Non-negotiable acceptance constraints for a future adapter, not claims about an existing Hanson implementation.

depth.description: Required and positive when history is keep_last; otherwise optional because official middleware conventions may still report it.

safetySemantics.description: Official safety mappings remain unresolved; constant fields are acceptance requirements rather than assertions about current products.

simulatorEvidence.description: A local validation record for exact named versions. The semantic validator also rejects Git's all-zero null object id and completion times more than five minutes in the future.
